schema.name: graph_meta
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE graph_meta(key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,value TEXT NOT NULL) WITHOUT ROWID

schema.name: graph_sources
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE graph_sources(path TEXT PRIMARY KEY,revision TEXT NOT NULL,data TEXT NOT NULL) WITHOUT ROWID

schema.name: graph_nodes
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE graph_nodes(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,kind TEXT NOT NULL,revision TEXT NOT NULL,data TEXT NOT NULL) WITHOUT ROWID

schema.name: graph_evidence
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE graph_evidence(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,source_path TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES graph_sources(path) ON DELETE CASCADE,data TEXT NOT NULL) WITHOUT ROWID

schema.name: graph_edges
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE graph_edges(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,from_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES graph_nodes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,to_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES graph_nodes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,predicate TEXT NOT NULL,data TEXT NOT NULL) WITHOUT ROWID

schema.name: graph_edges_from
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX graph_edges_from ON graph_edges(from_id,predicate)

schema.name: graph_edges_to
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX graph_edges_to ON graph_edges(to_id,predicate)

schema.name: graph_edge_evidence
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE graph_edge_evidence(edge_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES graph_edges(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,evidence_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES graph_evidence(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,PRIMARY KEY(edge_id,evidence_id)) WITHOUT ROWID

schema.name: graph_node_sources
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE graph_node_sources(node_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES graph_nodes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,source_path TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES graph_sources(path) ON DELETE CASCADE,PRIMARY KEY(node_id,source_path)) WITHOUT ROWID

schema.name: graph_aux
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE graph_aux(key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,data TEXT NOT NULL) WITHOUT ROWID

schema.name: graph_documents_insert
schema.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER graph_documents_insert AFTER INSERT ON documents BEGIN
                INSERT INTO graph_meta VALUES('state','stale') ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value='stale'; END

schema.name: graph_documents_delete
schema.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER graph_documents_delete AFTER DELETE ON documents BEGIN
                INSERT INTO graph_meta VALUES('state','stale') ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value='stale'; END

schema.name: graph_documents_change
schema.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER graph_documents_change AFTER UPDATE OF hash,path ON documents WHEN OLD.hash<>NEW.hash OR OLD.path<>NEW.path BEGIN
                INSERT INTO graph_meta VALUES('state','stale') ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value='stale'; END

schema.name: graph_read_graph_meta_INSERT
schema.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER graph_read_graph_meta_INSERT AFTER INSERT ON graph_meta WHEN NEW.key NOT IN ('read_revision','read_epoch','knn_prepared','knn_checkpoint','knn_complete','knn_input_revision','knn_input_epoch') BEGIN
                UPDATE graph_meta SET value=CAST(value AS INTEGER)+1 WHERE key='read_revision'; END

schema.name: graph_read_graph_meta_UPDATE
schema.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER graph_read_graph_meta_UPDATE AFTER UPDATE ON graph_meta WHEN NEW.key NOT IN ('read_revision','read_epoch','knn_prepared','knn_checkpoint','knn_complete','knn_input_revision','knn_input_epoch') BEGIN
                UPDATE graph_meta SET value=CAST(value AS INTEGER)+1 WHERE key='read_revision'; END

schema.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER graph_read_graph_meta_DELETE AFTER DELETE ON graph_meta WHEN OLD.key NOT IN ('read_revision','read_epoch','knn_prepared','knn_checkpoint','knn_complete','knn_input_revision','knn_input_epoch') BEGIN
                UPDATE graph_meta SET value=CAST(value AS INTEGER)+1 WHERE key='read_revision'; END
